summary: @qlik/design-tokens preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, extracts and chmods the binary executable, then invokes it via execFileSync against a bundled 727KB sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator-style hex identifiers `_0x488df8`, shuffled string-array rotation dispatcher, char-code decoding tables, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) and is not consumed as a library by the package's declared design-tokens purpose (CSS variables / JSON). setup.mjs itself also contains obfuscator-style identifiers. The Bun release tag is derived from the package's own version string `V = "1.3.13"` rather than a pinned runtime version, coupling the fetched external artifact to the publisher's package version. Fetching an alternate language runtime specifically to execute an opaque obfuscated bundled payload at install time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern; a design-tokens library has no functional need for a second language runtime or an obfuscated 727KB executable blob. Installing this version causes arbitrary code contained in math_init.js to run on the installer's host under the downloaded Bun binary, bypassing Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
